items.query: Which tree species had the highest carbon storage potential in the Mandi-Bahauddin agroforestry study?
expected_source_titles: Carbon Storage Potential of Agroforestry System near Brick Kilns
items.reference_answer: Eucalyptus camaldulensis, with the highest carbon stock recorded (3951 Mg C ha⁻¹ in Tehsil Mandi-Bahauddin).

items.query: What is the descending order of carbon storage potential among tree species across Mandi-Bahauddin district overall?

items.query: Which tree's bark is traditionally used to treat nose bleeds in Mandi Bahauddin?
expected_source_titles: Ethnomedicinal Flora of District Mandi Bahaudin
items.reference_answer: Dalbergia sissoo (local name Tali/Rosewood) — bark used for nose bleed.

items.query: What part of Acacia nilotica is used ethnomedicinally, and for what condition?

items.query: What is the average soil carbon pool range measured in the Mandi-Bahauddin agroforestry study?
expected_source_titles: Carbon Storage Potential of Agroforestry System near Brick Kilns
items.reference_answer: Roughly 10.3–12.5 Mg C ha⁻¹ (tehsil averages ranged 10.3–15.3 Mg C ha⁻¹ depending on distance from brick kilns).

items.query: What soil texture classification does Mandi Bahauddin district fall into, and what is its organic matter range?
expected_source_titles: Carbon Storage Potential of Agroforestry System near Brick Kilns
items.reference_answer: Loam to clay loam soil (USDA classification), with organic matter ranging from 0.50–1.01%.

items.query: Which edaphic (soil) factors were found to have the strongest association with native plant species distribution in Mandi Baha Uddin?
expected_source_titles: Native Vegetation Correlation with Environmental Gradients
items.reference_answer: N, SOC, K, P, Sand, and SOM showed the dominant association; soil pH and clay were negatively associated with native species distribution.

items.query: According to the invasive plant study, which soil factors most influence where invasive alien species establish in Mandi Bahauddin?
expected_source_titles: Invasive Plants Diversity, Ecological Status
items.reference_answer: pH, moisture, soil saturation, organic matter, nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), and calcium carbonate (CaCO3).
